educational_units.title: Breast density definition
educational_units.description: Definition is based on relative proportion of parenchyma to fat, not absolute tissue amount.

educational_units.title: BI-RADS A-D categories and dense/non-dense grouping
educational_units.description: A/B are non-dense; C/D are dense; category descriptions must be distinguished accurately.

educational_units.title: Regulatory reporting requirements
educational_units.description: Federal reporting requirement since September 2024 and July 2025 alternative unilateral wording standard.

educational_units.title: Breast density risk statistics
educational_units.description: Breast density is a risk factor with odds ratios including 0.6, 1.4, and 1.6 compared to scattered fibroglandular tissue.

educational_units.title: Masking effect and mammographic sensitivity
educational_units.description: Dense fibroglandular tissue can obscure cancers and reduce sensitivity.

educational_units.title: Technology progression and quantitative evidence
educational_units.description: Film-screen to digital to DBT; DMIST sensitivity ~55% to ~70% in dense breasts; detection rate 4.5/1000 to 5.8/1000 with DBT.

educational_units.title: Classification rationale and practical rules
educational_units.description: Shift from percentage-based to likelihood of obscuring cancer; local region masking matters; assign greater density if breasts differ; density can vary over time.

educational_units.title: Assessment process
educational_units.description: Visual subjective assessment on mammographic views and possible FDA-approved software assistance.

educational_units.title: Numbers and dates accuracy
educational_units.description: Use factual substitutions around 55%, 70%, 4.5/1000, 5.8/1000, September 2024, and July 2025.

educational_units.title: Terminology and risk distortions
educational_units.description: Trap incorrect dense/non-dense grouping, risk odds ratios, and category definitions.

educational_units.title: Why BI-RADS density classification changed
educational_units.description: Explain shift from percentage dense tissue to masking-likelihood logic and rationale.

educational_units.title: Why DBT helps in dense breasts
educational_units.description: Explain masking effect and slice-by-slice viewing reducing overlap of tissue.

educational_units.title: Breast density categories ordered A to D
educational_units.description: Explicit order of BI-RADS density categories by increasing density / masking potential.
